title: Pokémon Card Collection Value Guide — Estimates, sealed products and limits | Lunidex
h1: How to estimate Pokémon card collection value with Lunidex
main:
USAGE GUIDE

How to estimate Pokémon card collection value with Lunidex

A fact-first guide to the value signals available in Lunidex, with a clear boundary between upstream estimates, a private sealed portfolio, and a professional appraisal.

PUBLISHED SEP 21, 2026 · CHECKED AGAINST LUNIDEX SOURCE AND PUBLIC ROUTES ON SEP 28, 2026.

Lunidex editorial

Short answer

Lunidex can show conditional card price fields and collection estimates when upstream TCGdex data is available. Its account-backed sealed portfolio can record purchases, sales, value, profit or loss, ROI, and source timestamps using the configured Cardmarket catalogue and price-guide data. These signals help organize a collection; they are not a guaranteed market valuation or appraisal.

What this guide covers

This guide covers ordinary card estimates in /tcg/collection and the private sealed-product portfolio in /tcg/sealed. The public guide is readable without an account, while personal portfolio records require the configured account and synchronization service.

What each value signal actually means

These distinctions keep a useful collection estimate separate from claims Lunidex cannot verify.

What each value signal actually means
CRITERION	LUNIDEX
Ordinary card estimate	A visible estimate based on upstream TCGdex price fields when the card record supplies them.
Sealed portfolio	Private account-backed records for supported sealed products, purchases, sales, value, profit or loss, and ROI.
Price history	Snapshots for supported card IDs or synced sealed data when the configured source path has history; not a universal market timeline.
Source and freshness	Cardmarket catalogue and price-guide imports expose source context and timestamps; upstream updates can change coverage and numbers.
Market limits	No authentication, condition grading, liquidity guarantee, appraisal, or transaction checkout is provided by Lunidex.
How to use these features
01

Open a card or set in the public TCG catalog and check whether the upstream card record includes the price fields needed for an estimate.

02

Use the collection workspace to review owned cards, missing cards, set progress, and the visible conditional estimate when price data is supplied.

03

Sign in before using /tcg/sealed to record sealed-product purchases, sales, cost basis, value, profit or loss, and ROI in your private portfolio.

04

Read the source and timestamp alongside any number, then compare important decisions with the current marketplace listing and product condition instead of treating the estimate as an appraisal.

Boundaries and practical limits

Coverage, freshness, currency, product matching, condition, language, seller context, and upstream availability can change. Price history exists only where the supported data path has snapshots. Lunidex does not authenticate a card, guarantee liquidity, or provide financial or appraisal advice.

Lunidex is a free-to-use web workspace for public Pokémon TCG research, personal collection state, a Pokédex, and team tools. Lunidex does not replace a marketplace transaction flow.

What Cardmarket is built for

The checked Cardmarket pages and public product files establish marketplace/product and price information. They do not establish a Pokédex, Pokémon team builder, open-source codebase, or a Lunidex-style all-in-one personal workspace.

Feature comparison matrix
CRITERION	LUNIDEX	CARDMARKET
Platform	Web app with an installable PWA experience.	Marketplace website and public product/price data pages.
Main scope	Pokémon TCG catalog and personal collection state alongside Pokédex and team tools.	Pokémon TCG marketplace listings, product catalogue, and market-related data.
Card scanner	A card scanner is not established in the checked Lunidex sources.	A card-scanner workflow is not established in the checked Cardmarket sources.
Prices	TCGdex price fields and estimates when supplied; not an appraisal.	Marketplace/product price data is provided through Cardmarket pages and public product files; prices and availability can change.
Offline use	The shell and cached pages may work offline; new data needs a connection.	Offline collection or marketplace use is not established in the checked official sources.
Account and sync	Personal collection state uses the configured account-backed sync path.	A Cardmarket account supports marketplace activity, but a Lunidex-style private collection sync workflow is not established in the checked sources.
Cost	No purchase, subscription, or payment flow is present in the current code.	Marketplace fees, shipping, and transaction terms depend on the current Cardmarket rules and transaction.
Wishlist	Wishlist state is available in the account-backed TCG workspace.	A Lunidex-style personal wishlist workflow is not established in the checked official sources.
Pokédex	Localized Pokédex reference routes are part of the same web application.	Cardmarket is not presented as a general Pokémon video-game Pokédex.
Team builder	The product includes a Pokémon Team Builder and related analysis tools.	A Pokémon team-builder workflow is not established in the checked official sources.
Open source	The Lunidex source repository is public under the project licence.	An open-source Cardmarket codebase is not established by the checked marketplace sources.
Limits	Coverage, freshness, upstream fields, and account availability limit what Lunidex can show; values are not appraisals.	Listings, seller conditions, fees, availability, and market prices require current Cardmarket checks and do not make a guaranteed valuation.

Feature statements were checked against the linked public sources on the date shown above. “Not stated” means the checked source did not establish the feature, not that it can never exist.
